bio: Located in a neighbourhood with a unique character, this appealing, laid-back restaurant has plenty of regulars. Welcoming and lively, it's everything a brasserie should be. The menu, too, is down-to-earth, including mouthwatering options – house-made venison ham, brasserie classics such as steak-frites and vegetarian dishes. Tip: Take a punt on the moderately priced surprise menu. Friendly and professional service. Pavement terrace....
